summary: The stale runbook was replaced with an explicit retirement notice linking to the standalone ubiquity/sentinel repository.

evidence: docs/sentinel.md explicitly states that Provider Sentinel automation is retired and no longer part of this repository.
The notice forbids restoring embedded workflows, schedules, incident dispatch, deployment credentials, and local verification tooling.
The page no longer contains the obsolete autonomy variable, local harness command, or provider-sentinel.yml workflow instructions, and links to https://github.com/ubiquity/sentinel.
